description:
IT Development Program (ITDP) – AI-Native Software Engineer 
  
 Dell IT is looking for a new kind of campus hire: AI-Native Engineers ready to make an accelerated impact from day one. As part of the IT Development Program (ITDP), you'll rotate across high-priority teams, partnering with experienced engineers, architects, data scientists, and product leaders to build intelligent solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. We are seeking recent graduates who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience applying Generative AI technologies such as copilots, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to solve real-world problems. 
  
 At Dell Technologies, we invest in the development of our early career talent through the IT Development Program (ITDP). Participants gain exposure to real-world business challenges, rotational experiences across multiple teams, direct mentorship from technology leaders, and opportunities to build innovative solutions that support Dell's digital transformation. 
  
 Throughout the program, participants develop technical expertise, business acumen, leadership capabilities, and a strong network across Dell IT. With opportunities spanning software engineering, AI, data, cloud platforms, and infrastructure participants can shape a career aligned to both their interests and business priorities. 
  
 What you’ll achieve  
 As a part of the IT Development Program, you'll experience rotations during your first two years in Dell IT. This rotation program is designed to provide broad exposure across different technology teams while helping you build the skills needed for a successful long-term career. 
  
 During the program, you will complete two one-year rotations before being placed in your final role upon graduation from the program. 
  
 You will be matched to teams based on: 
 Your technical skills and demonstrated capabilities 

 Your career interests and desired learning path 

 Team preferences identified through networking and exploration 

 Business priorities and manager selection processes 

  
 Throughout your rotations, you'll contribute to delivering business outcomes through modern software engineering, AI-powered solutions, data-driven decision making, and scalable enterprise platforms 
  
 Career Journeys in ITDP Rotation Program 
 Software Engineering  

 AI Engineering  

  
 Depending on business needs, your day-to-day role may include : 
 Develop and deploy AI-powered applications, assistants, agents, and intelligent workflows  

 Build scalable software solutions using cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices  

 Design and implement integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and AI services  

 Contribute to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and automation solutions that improve business productivity  

 Partners with architects, product managers, data scientists, and software engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions  

 Apply responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance principles throughout the development lifecycle  

 Participate in CI/CD, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence practices to ensure reliable and scalable solutions  

 Use data and experimentation to improve customer and employee experience  

 Learn emerging technologies quickly and apply them to real-world business challenges 

  
 Essential Requirement 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or Machine Learning with a graduation date of December 2026 or May 2027 

 Foundation in software engineering principles, including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, testing, and system design 

 Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or C++ 

 Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI-powered applications, including work with generative AI, LLMs, AI assistants, agents, prompt engineering, or RAG solutions 

 Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, communicate effectively, collaborate across teams, and deliver measurable results with accountability 

  
  
 Dell Culture Code/Power Skills Requirements 
 Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning, especially in emerging technologies and AI innovation  

 Takes ownership and accountability for delivering meaningful outcomes  

 Collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, and geographies  

 Adapts quickly to changing priorities and evolving business needs  

 Uses good judgment and embraces responsibility, ethical technology practices  

 Balances experimentation and innovation with operational excellence 

  
 Desirable Requirements  
 Demonstrated experience developing AI-powered solutions using modern AI/ML frameworks, including assistants, agents, workflow automation, and recommendation systems 

 Knowledge of cloud and software engineering practices, including APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD, data platforms, and evidence of applied innovation through projects, research, open source, or technical competitions 
  

 Compensation 
 Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary for this position is $89,520 USD annually 
  

 Who we are 
 We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members  at  the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. 
 Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that  helps  individuals and organizations transform how they work,  live  and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. 
 Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy   here .
